info.title: API.SH: FotMob
info.description: The FotMob API from API.SH: public FotMob data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A league or cup: name, country, season and every available season, tables (all, home, away, form and xG tables with played, wins, draws, losses, goals, goal difference, points, qualification legend), playoff bracket and the top three for every player and team stat.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-league

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: FotMob league id (from `/fotmob/v1/leagues` or `/fotmob/v1/search`; 47 = Premier League, 87 = LaLiga, 42 = Champions League).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season, e.g. 2023/2024 (or 2024 for calendar-year leagues). Default: the current one.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every match of a league season (results and fixtures) with round, kick-off, teams, scores, status and link; filter by round, team or finished/upcoming.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-league-fixtures

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: FotMob league id (from `/fotmob/v1/leagues` or `/fotmob/v1/search`; 47 = Premier League, 87 = LaLiga, 42 = Champions League).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season, e.g. 2023/2024 (or 2024 for calendar-year leagues). Default: the current one.

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: Only this round.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Only matches of this team id.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: all (default), finished, upcoming.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The full ranking for one player or team stat of a league season (goals, assists, xG, xA, rating, shots, passes, tackles, clean sheets ...): rank, player or team, country, value, sub-value, matches and minutes. Without `stat` it lists the stats available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-league-stats

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: FotMob league id (from `/fotmob/v1/leagues` or `/fotmob/v1/search`; 47 = Premier League, 87 = LaLiga, 42 = Champions League).

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season, e.g. 2023/2024 (or 2024 for calendar-year leagues). Default: the current one.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: Stat key from `available_stats` (e.g. goals, goal_assist, expected_goals, rating, clean_sheet).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: players (default) or teams.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every league and cup FotMob covers with its id: popular leagues, international competitions and each country's leagues.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-leagues

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Match facts also carry top scorers and the pre- and post-match reviews. Use `sections` to return only some parts; `sections=commentary` (only when named) adds the minute-by-minute text commentary with event type, minute, added time and players.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-match

parameters.name: match_id
parameters.description: FotMob match id (from `/fotmob/v1/matches` or fixtures; 4193901 = Arsenal v Everton, 19 May 2024).

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset: facts, stats, lineup, shotmap, momentum, player_stats, h2h, table (default: all of these), and commentary (only when named).

parameters.name: commentary_lang
parameters.description: Commentary language when the match has it (default en; e.g. de, en_gen, es_gen). `commentary.available_languages` lists them.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every football match FotMob lists for a day, grouped by league: match id, league, round, kick-off time, both teams (id, name, logo, score), score text, started/finished/cancelled flags, live minute, status and link. Filter by league ids.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-matches

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: Only these league ids (comma-separated).

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone that defines the day (default UTC).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The news feed FotMob shows for a league or a team: headline, source, publish time, image and link, 20 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-news

parameters.name: league_id
parameters.description: League id or FotMob league link.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: Team id or FotMob team link (instead of league_id).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: News language (en, de, es...).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A player: birth date, contract end, team, positions, injury, international duty, information (height, foot, shirt, market value, country), main league stats, traits, current season stats (with per-90 and percentiles), the seasons available, career history (clubs and national team with appearances and goals), market value history, recent matches with ratings, trophies and next match.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fotmob-player

parameters.name: player_id
parameters.description: FotMob player id (961995 = Bukayo Saka).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
